Likewise, the off-diagonal elements can be shown to have the solution [[SEE_FORMULA:28.28d]] showing the presence of negative LD at equilibrium, as expected from Chapter 16. Note, however, that the $ \tilde{C}_{ij} $ values are independent of the strength of selection, $ V_s $. Recalling Equation 28.25d, $ \tilde{C}_{ii} = \tilde{C}_i - \sum_{j \neq i} \tilde{C}_{ij} $, which yields [[SEE_FORMULA:28.28e]] Finally, because the equilibrium additive variance can be expressed in terms of the $ \widetilde{C}_i $, as $ \widetilde{\sigma}_A^2 = 2 \sum \widetilde{C}_i $, a little algebra yields [[SEE_FORMULA:28.28f]]
For $n$ equivalent loci, $\sigma_m^2 = 2n\mu\sigma_\alpha^2$, reducing $Z$ to $n\sqrt{\mu\sigma_\alpha^2}$, so $2Z^2 = 2n^2\mu\sigma_\alpha^2 = n\sigma_m^2$, and we recover Equation 28.14c.
